lines.en: : I told you to stop looking at that.
lines.zh: : 我叫过你别看那个。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I must’ve gotten lost or something.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我大概是走神了之类的。
: 别看那个。
: 那到底{i}是什么{/i}？
: 什么是哪个？

lines.en: : The thing you just told me to stop looking at, obviously.
lines.zh: : 显然是你刚叫我别看的那东西。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. We just got here.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在说什么。我们才刚到。

lines.en: : Look behind you. Either that or step aside for a second. There’s-
lines.zh: : 看看你身后。或者让开一下。那里有——
: 不用。
: Amy，别这样。

lines.en: : Akira, just trust me! I’ve been here enough times to know what is and isn’t safe, okay? Your best bet is to just do what I say.
lines.zh: : Akira，你就信我吧！我来过这里够多次，知道什么安全什么不安全，行吗？你最好的选择就是照我说的做。

lines.en: : How have you been here so many times if the Blissful Biosphere only just opened, though?
lines.zh: : 可极乐生物圈才刚开，你怎么会来过这么多次？

lines.en: : I...I obviously meant the mall, silly! If I knew {i}that thing{/i} was here, I’d have never let you follow the road that brought us to it in the first place! Hahaha!
lines.zh: : 我……我当然是指这个商场，傻瓜！要是我早知道{i}那东西{/i}在这儿，我根本不会让你顺着那条把我们带过来的路走！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : So you acknowledge its existence after all?
lines.zh: : 所以你还是承认它存在了？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}fine. Yes, I acknowledge its existence. But I probably {i}shouldn’t!{/i} Because now it knows {i}you{/i} exist too. And that opens up a brand new can of snakes. And not the good kind either!
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}好吧。对，我承认它存在。但我大概{i}不该{/i}承认！因为现在它也知道{i}你{/i}存在了。而这会打开一罐全新的蛇。而且不是好的那种！

lines.en: : It’s sentient? It just looked like a black square to me. Or maybe even one of those temporal rift things.
lines.zh: : 它有知觉？在我眼里它只是个黑色方块。或者甚至像是那种时间裂隙。

lines.en: : It looks different to everybody. That’s the problem.
lines.zh: : 它在每个人眼里都不一样。这就是问题所在。

lines.en: : You remember those old cartoons where somebody would be wandering through the desert and then start hallucinating some sort of massive oasis with a bunch of water? It’s like that.
lines.zh: : 你记得那些老卡通吧，有人会在沙漠里游荡，然后开始幻觉出某种有一大堆水的大绿洲？就跟那个一样。
: 那它就是海市蜃楼？

lines.en: : Not exactly. Mirages are just a visual hallucination at the end of the day. {i}This{/i} is a thing that’s actually real. It just makes itself look like something else. Usually whatever you want to see the most.
lines.zh: : 不完全是。说到底，海市蜃楼只是一种视觉幻觉。{i}这{/i}东西是真实存在的。它只是把自己伪装成别的东西。通常是你最想看到的东西。
: 那你看到的是什么？
: 当然是你啊！

lines.en: : So there’s just another me behind you right now?
lines.zh: : 所以现在你身后就站着另一个我？

lines.en: : Hey, I had a dream about that once. Boy, do I regret waking up.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我做过一次关于这个的梦。天啊，我真后悔醒过来。
: Amy，认真点。

lines.en: : Sorry! Hahah! Yes, there’s another you back there. Just...standing around and staring off into the distance.
lines.zh: : 抱歉！哈哈！对，你身后还有另一个你。就……站在那儿，盯着远处发呆。

lines.en: : How do you know I’m the real one then? Maybe the real me is back there and I’m the mirage?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么知道我是真的那个？说不定真的我在后面，而我是那个幻象？

lines.en: : Oh, that’s easy. The fake one’s like a really weak vacuum. It kind of like...sucks you in. But really gently. And you haven’t tried sucking me in yet, so you’re definitely the real you!
lines.zh: : 哦，那很简单。假的就像个特别弱的吸尘器。它会有点……把你吸进去。但非常轻。而你还没试着把我吸进去，所以你绝对是真的你！

lines.en: : I guess I’ll be a little more careful about how intensely I inhale while you’re over here.
lines.zh: : 那我想，你在这边的时候，我吸气会小心一点。

lines.en: : Just don’t be {i}too{/i} careful! There haven’t been any tests on prolonged exposure to the Blissful Biosphere’s air yet. So there’s a chance we might need more of it and you could be suffocating yourself!
lines.zh: : 只是别{i}太{/i}小心！目前还没人测过长时间暴露在极乐生物圈空气下的影响。所以有可能我们需要更多这种空气，而你是在把自己闷死！

lines.en: : If that happens, can I have your feet?
lines.zh: : 如果真那样，你的脚能给我吗？
: 拿来干嘛?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Just to have them, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不知道。大概就是想要而已。

lines.en: : You just want to wear them so you stop falling over, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你就是想穿上它们好不再摔倒，对吧？

lines.en: : Wha...nuh-uh! Maybe I just really like feet! You have a problem with that, Akira?
lines.zh: : 什……才不是！说不定我就是特别喜欢脚！你有意见吗，Akira？

lines.en: : No, I don’t. I get it. I kind of like them too.
lines.zh: : 没有，我没意见。我懂。我也挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : Guh! Curse the way this body is shaped!
lines.zh: : 呃！诅咒这身体的形状！

lines.en: : {i}Maybe I can steal a pair off somebody else and...{/i}huh?
lines.zh: : {i}说不定我能从别人身上偷一双，然后……{/i}嗯？
: Amy？出什么事了吗？
: 你感觉到了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t feel anything other than the soft vibration of the floor. That’s been a constant the whole time we’ve been here, though.
lines.zh: : 除了地板轻微的震动，我什么都没感觉到。不过那从我们到这儿起就一直是这样。

lines.en: : I think the thing is trying to suck us in! Come on, Akira!
lines.zh: : 我觉得那东西在试着把我们吸进去！快，Akira！

lines.en: : We’ve gotta get out of here!
lines.zh: : 我们得离开这儿！
: Akira！我说了「快走」！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I forgot what I was doing for a second.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我有一瞬间忘了自己在干什么。
不往前走
不往前走
横着走
路边
路边
